label: tp-driver-prod2-10y
_why: STAGE 1d (overnight): the REVISED production calibration. 20261019_002008 (driver 20% a year, desire >= 25, 5-year cooldown) put treaty-port demands at 6-40% of active war goals (median ~14%), nearly all against Russia and the Ottomans - the only recognised hosts above 25 - with up to five AIs on Kherson at once and almost no port created. Revised: 10% a year, desire >= 15 (Spain, Portugal, Brazil, Sweden, the Netherlands, the Ottomans qualify beside Russia), 8-year cooldown, and the host must be in no committed play.
